This data is monthly unemployment rate data for the United States and four individual states, from FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data database). This data is from 1976 - present.

3.2: Change your code to load the saved data in the future + 3.1: Load and save your data

library(tidyquant)

library(tidyverse)

unemp_raw \<- tq_get(

c("UNRATE", "ORUR", "CAUR", "TXUR", "NYUR"),

get = "economic.data",

from = "1976-01-01" )

head(unemp_raw)

dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)

saveRDS(unemp_raw, "data/unemp_raw.rds")

unemp_raw = read_rds("data/unemp_raw.rds")
